title: Philadelphia Free Food and Meal Sites
publisher: City of Philadelphia, Office of Children and Families (with Philabundance, SHARE and partner food banks)
notes: Active food pantries, free grocery sites, community fridges and free meal sites only. Excluded: Office of Homeless Services meal sites (shelter locations), WIC / BenePhilly / Neighborhood Community Action Center benefit sites (social services) and PCA / PPR senior meal sites (older adults), plus permanently closed sites. Food-bank homepages given as a site's website are left blank. Every address was geocoded (City AIS, Census fallback): citywide 55 source points lying more than 250 m from their own address (mostly Caring for Friends sites) were moved to the address; 2 addresses could not be geocoded and keep the source point.

title: Farmers' Market Locations
publisher: City of Philadelphia (compiled from market managers and operators)
notes: All listed markets; schedule, season and SNAP / FMNP / Philly Food Bucks acceptance in detail. Operator name and phone kept only when the operator is an organisation (individual farmers' names and phones are left out).

title: SNAP Retailer Locator: authorized retailers
publisher: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Food and Nutrition Service (SNAP Retailer Policy and Management Division)
license: U.S. Government work; no license stated on the item
data_date: layer last edited 2026-11-05 (USDA updates every 2 weeks)
notes: Kept USDA store types Supermarket, Super Store, Grocery Store, Specialty Store and Farmers and Markets; dropped Convenience Store and Other (pharmacies, dollar and gas-station stores). Store type is USDA's classification; many small 'Grocery Store' retailers are corner stores with limited fresh food.

title: OpenStreetMap supermarkets, grocery stores and produce markets
notes: shop=supermarket, greengrocer and grocery (convenience stores skipped). Gap filler for the USDA list; OSM coverage of small stores is incomplete.

title: PHS Community Garden Program: PHS- and NGT-supported gardens (current)
publisher: Pennsylvania Horticultural Society (PHS), with Neighborhood Gardens Trust (NGT)
license: No license stated; public layer shared by PHS
notes: Active gardens in PHS's Community Garden Program ('CGP active gardens'). The current layer has no addresses, so the address comes from PHS's December 2022 supported-gardens layer when a garden point lies within 40 m.

title: Registered Community Gardens
publisher: Philadelphia Parks & Recreation, Urban Agriculture Team
notes: Active gardens registered with PPR's Urban Agriculture Team (a short citywide list of 23; most community gardens are not registered). Contact emails left out.

title: Urban Agriculture Projects
notes: Active urban agriculture projects on PPR sites (10 citywide). Contact emails left out.

title: OpenStreetMap community gardens and urban farms
notes: landuse=allotments (community garden), landuse=farmland / farmyard (urban farm) and leisure=garden with garden:type=community. Polygons placed at a point inside; unnamed features are labelled by type.

title: PPR Properties (parks as points)
notes: One point inside each PPR property polygon (inside the part that lies within 1.5 mi of a site for large parks); acreage is the whole property. Dropped traffic islands / medians, pathways, internal operational sites and older-adult-center properties; PPR garden / farm properties are tagged gardens_farms.

title: Parks & Recreation Program Sites
notes: Recreation centers / staffed recreation sites, program pools and environmental education centers. Older adult centers (program_type OLDER_ADULT_CENTER) excluded for the health domain. Address taken from the PPR property the point sits in.

title: PPR Playgrounds
notes: PPR play areas (grouped by age range). Play areas of the same park within 40 m are merged into one point with the count and age ranges in detail.

title: PPR Spraygrounds
notes: Active spraygrounds and sprinklers only (status INACTIVE / UNKNOWN dropped).

title: PPR Swimming Pools
notes: Active PPR pools (inactive pools dropped). Pool status is PPR's facility status, not this season's opening schedule.

title: PPR Tennis Courts
notes: One record per court in the source; courts at the same park within 40 m are merged into one point with a count.

title: OpenStreetMap courts, athletic fields, tracks, rinks and skateparks
notes: leisure=pitch / track / ice_rink / skatepark, typed by sport; access=private / customers dropped, as are painted schoolyard games (four square, gaga). Adjacent same-type courts within 40 m merged with a count. Detail says whether the facility sits in a PPR park, on school grounds or on a college campus (school courts may not be open to the public). Fills the gap left by PPR, which publishes no ballfield / basketball court layer.

title: OpenStreetMap parks, playgrounds and dog parks outside PPR property
notes: Gap filler: named leisure=park / nature_reserve, leisure=playground and leisure=dog_park whose point lies outside every PPR property (playgrounds also > 60 m from a PPR play area); includes township parks across the city line, institutional and housing-site playgrounds. access=private / customers dropped; detail flags school grounds.

title: OpenStreetMap trailheads
notes: highway=trailhead nodes (mostly Wissahickon Valley Park entrances). No official City trailhead point layer exists; PPR publishes trails only as lines.
